fusions.name: Cold-Shoe Strike
fusions.desc: A shod kick at a target at or below 20% health that deals 20 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Grey Wake
fusions.desc: You plough through a cone up to 5 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to everything in it.

fusions.name: Cold-Forged Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is turned back on whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Unbowed Stance
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (62% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
